title.ko: 가정해 보기: 제2 조건문 (If I had...)

ex.t: Si je gagnais à la loterie, je voyagerais.
ex.en: If I won the lottery, I would travel.

ex.t: Si j'étais riche, j'achèterais une grande maison.
ex.ko: 내가 부자라면 큰 집을 살 거예요.
ex.en: If I were rich, I would buy a big house.

ex.t: Si j'avais plus de temps, je ferais du sport.
ex.en: If I had more time, I would exercise.
I would travel around the world.

ex.t: À ta place, j'irais chez le médecin.
ex.en: If I were you, I would see a doctor.

ex.t: Mon rêve est de devenir écrivain.
ex.en: My dream is to be a writer.

ex.t: Je ne quitterais pas mon travail.

ex.en: Maybe I would go to Paris.

explain.ko: 실현 가능성이 낮거나 상상 속인 상황은 si + 반과거, 조건법 현재로 말합니다. 조건법은 미래형 어간에 반과거 어미 (-ais, -ais, -ait, -ions, -iez, -aient)를 붙입니다: je voyagerais. 조언은 'À ta place, j'irais …'로 말하고, si 뒤에는 조건법을 쓰지 않습니다.
explain.en: Imaginary or unlikely situations use si + imperfect, present conditional. The conditional is the future stem + imperfect endings (-ais, -ais, -ait, -ions, -iez, -aient): je voyagerais. Give advice with 'À ta place, j'irais …'. Never use the conditional after si.

lines.t: Que ferais-tu si tu gagnais à la loterie ?

trans.en: (Question) What would you do if you won the lottery?

lines.t: Que ferais-tu si tu avais plus de temps ?

trans.ko: (질문) 시간이 더 있다면 뭘 할 거예요?
trans.en: (Question) What would you do if you had more time?

lines.t: Que ferais-tu si tu gagnais à la loterie ?
Je voyagerais autour du monde. Et toi ?
J'achèterais une grande maison et j'aiderais les pauvres.

trans.ko:
A: 복권에 당첨되면 뭘 할래?
B: 세계를 여행할 거야. 너는?
A: 나는 큰 집을 사고 가난한 사람들을 도울 거야.
B: 정말 좋은 생각이야.
trans.en:
A: What would you do if you won the lottery?
B: I would travel around the world. What about you?
A: I would buy a big house and help poor people.
B: That's a really good idea.

lines.t: Mon rêve est de devenir écrivain. Si j'avais plus de temps, j'écrirais tous les jours. Si j'avais plus d'argent, je travaillerais moins et j'habiterais à Paris. Mais pour l'instant, je dois aller à l'école.

trans.ko: 제 꿈은 작가가 되는 거예요. 시간이 더 있다면 매일 글을 쓸 거예요. 돈이 더 있다면 일을 줄이고 파리에서 살 거예요. 하지만 지금은 학교에 가야 해요.
trans.en: My dream is to be a writer. If I had more time, I would write every day. If I had more money, I would work less and live in Paris. But now I have to go to school.

lines.t: Que feriez-vous si vous gagniez à la loterie ?
Non, je ne le quitterais pas.

trans.ko:
직원: 복권에 당첨되면 뭘 하실 거예요?
손님: 큰 집을 살 거예요.
직원: 일은 그만두실 거예요?
손님: 아니요, 그만두지 않을 거예요.
trans.en:
Interviewer: What would you do if you won the lottery?
Guest: I would buy a big house.
Interviewer: Would you quit your job?
Guest: No, I wouldn't quit.
